items.passage: I would like to give guidance for FY '25 EXIM, we are hoping 15% growth. Domestic, we are hoping 25% growth. That makes overall 18% to 20% growth in FY '25.
And our margins, EBITDA, which is in the range of 25%, we are very confident that we will be able to maintain the 25% EBITDA in this financial year also.
